name: Ranged Damage Master
body:
You are able to tap far into the power of the arcane and imbue your non-magical arrows with a wide range of damage types, guaranteeing that you’ll be able to do the kind of damage the hurts your enemies the most.

Prerequisite(s): 5th-level arcane archer

Benefit: When you use your Enhance Arrows (Elemental) ability, you have a wider range of elemental themes that you can choose from. Along with the flaming, frost, and shock themes, you now have access to acid, sonic, positive, and negative damage.
